literal: The wealth of him who possesses impartiality, without decay, to his posterity protection it has.
translation: The wealth of a person of upright impartiality will not diminish; it will stand as a protective shield for their posterity.
modern: நடுவுநிலைமை உடையவனுடைய செல்வமானது அழிவில்லாமல் அவனுடைய சந்ததிக்குப் பாதுகாப்பாக விளங்கும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the enduring value of impartiality, referred to here as 'ceppam'. The author asserts that the wealth accumulated by an upright, fair-minded person does not perish or decay. Instead, it remains secure and serves as a source of strength and protection for their descendants or posterity, termed 'eccam'. The word 'eccam' literally means 'that which is left behind', referring to one's children and future generations. Thus, practicing fairness not only benefits the individual during their lifetime but also secures the well-being of their lineage.
